description: File the business name that landlines show when the business's number calls out (caller ID name). Included with the business's own text registration once it is paid; charges nothing. Business owner only. The name must be at most 15 characters, start with a letter, and use only letters, numbers, periods, commas and spaces (get_text_registration returns a suggestion in branded_caller_id.suggestedName). Files with the carriers once the business profile is approved; review then takes a day or two and carriers show it within 72 hours. US local numbers only. The result confirms the filing, not that the name is showing on calls.

display_name.description: Up to 15 characters, e.g. SUMMIT ROOFING.
